therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: enhancement of prefrontal cortical noradrenergic/dopaminergic neurotransmission to improve cognition
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Cognitive function assessed by CDR computerised battery (episodic memory, working memory, attention) and adverse events over 3 months

results.effect_size: Quality of Episodic Memory: low dose 100.7, high dose 85.0 vs placebo 46.3; Quality of Memory: low dose 216.53, high dose 196.37 vs placebo 117.15
results.target_engagement_evidence: Plasma trough concentrations at week 12: low dose 18.4 ng/ml, high dose 61.0 ng/ml
biomarker_changes: ORM-12741 plasma trough concentration at week 12: low dose 18.4 ng/ml, high dose 61.0 ng/ml, placebo 0 ng/ml
safety_signals: Adverse events occurred in 18/33 low dose, 21/33 high dose, and 21/33 placebo participants
One serious adverse event of cholestasis reported in the high dose arm (1/33)
